g.text: I am Rohit, an aspiring data scientist who turns raw, disorderly
data into decisions of consequence. My work spans data engineering,
automation and applied machine learning: from retail ETL pipelines and
enterprise invoice intelligence to civic-tech platforms that carry a
citizen’s voice straight to the authorities who must answer it.
To me, analysis is never mere arithmetic; it is the pursuit of clarity,
accountability and the lasting impression a well-engineered insight leaves.
